rows.text: Address headed 'Cérémonie d'investiture', 'Palais de l'Elysée', '15 mai 2012', delivered to 'Monsieur le Président de la République', recalling that on 6 May 2012 'vous avez recueilli 18 000 668 voix' and that the Council proclaimed him elected 'le 10 mai dernier'.

locator.item: heading and first two body paragraphs

rows.text: The address states that 'vous devenez ainsi le septième Président de la Cinquième République' and 'A compter de ce jour, 15 mai 2012, et pour la durée de votre mandat, vous incarnez la France, symbolisez la République et ses valeurs'.

locator.item: first and second paragraphs after the second salutation 'Monsieur le Président de la République' (body paragraphs 3-4)

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-23 only (Président de la République, 1 January 1990 to the 7 September 2026 cutoff). Election rounds, the Constitutional Council's proclamation, its publication, the investiture ceremony, a stated start of term, an outer limit and any stated end stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Prime ministers, ministers, party offices and the President of the Senate's interim office are excluded.
